ideas.pitch: An edge-compute safety and telemetry hardware add-on for 8kg/15kg combat robots that monitors internal temperatures, impacts, and implements an automatic kill-switch upon connection loss.
ideas.title: Arena Telemetry & Autonomous Failsafe Module
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on safety compliance and reliability, which are core evaluation metrics in combat robotics, while mimicking the robust hardware edge architecture of winning defense and hardware projects.

ideas.pitch: A wireless first-person-view camera system paired with an overlay computer that tracks spinning weapon RPM using optical sensors to give drivers real-time performance metrics.
ideas.title: Low-Latency FPV Combat HUD with Weapon RPM Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines custom hardware integration with a live, working physical demo that directly impacts driving skill and strategy during the 3-minute active fight time.

ideas.pitch: A digitally designed and rapidly fabricatable modular armor system with embedded strain gauges to help teams optimize weight distribution for either the 8kg or 15kg class limits.
ideas.title: Modular Quick-Swap Armor Weight Management Rig
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles engineering design and reliability by solving a physical constraint unique to combat robotics competitions.

ideas.pitch: An offline computer vision system set up over the testing arena that tracks robot movement vectors and collision hotspots during sparring matches to refine double-elimination tactics.
ideas.title: Match Strategy Replay & Impact Heatmapping Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies data analytics to robot strategy, giving teams a competitive edge in match planning and impressing judges with advanced engineering execution.

ideas.pitch: A portable diagnostic tool that tests PWM signals, motor controller health, and failsafe responses instantly in the pit area before entering the combat arena.
ideas.title: Redundant Fail-Safe Receiver and ESC Diagnostic Box
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses reliability and safety compliance, ensuring the robot survives tournament stress and performs consistently across double-elimination rounds.
